author: Annika Orsholt

text: One of the good apps in its category. It seems the calculation for 'habit strength' could be improved. Case: I track instances of a bad habit I want to limit, like junk food. I set a limit of max. 3 times junkfood per week. Whether I exceed that limit by 1 or 2 doesnt seem to make a difference to the algorithm. My habit meter falls by the same amount. But that should make a difference.
author: Kristoffer Nielsen
developer_reply: Thank you for your review! This is true, we only take into account the fact that you missed your goal, we don’t look at by how much. Sometimes, when you miss that goal, it’s more beneficial to get that craving out of your system so you can return stronger. This is what habit strength is about, how strong(low effort) it is for you.
